scope: Proposition 7.1 (Massive tightness) of the manuscript “The unique threshold bound state of the SU(N) BFSS model” (preprints/The-unique-threshold-bound-state-of-the-SU-N-BFSS-model-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 270 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7a4b12bd2a7e8902), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 40. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are a > 0, h0 > 0, and R0 < ∞, depending on N, such that qh,1(ψ) ≥ aR2 ∥ψ∥2 if h ≥ h0, R ≥ R0, supp ψ ⊂ {R < |x| < 4R}. (7.1) This inequality is on gauge invariants, with no rotation restriction. Consequently, for R ≥ R0, after enlarging the constants if needed, ∫︂ |x|>4R |ψ|2 ≤ C R2 qh,1(ψ) + C R4 ∥ψ∥2 , h ≥ h0. (7.2) In particular, every bounded sequence of gauge- and G-invariant vectors with h → ∞ and bounded Du(h, 1) graph norms has tight squared norm measures.
